title: decisions log surfaces active conflict candidates in its output
action: On every successful `decisions log` (and on the prose-guard refusal), compute up to 3 conflict candidates from the ACTIVE decision set: rank by the same deterministic term-hit scoring `decisions search` uses (whitespace-split terms of the new decision text, case-insensitive, matched over decision/rationale/alternatives and overlay-applied tags), considering only events that share >=1 final tag with the new event OR score >=2 term hits; exclude the just-written event and anything already superseded/redacted. Success output gains a `conflict_candidates` array [{id, short8, date, excerpt (first 90 chars), hits}] plus one human line per candidate ('possible conflict: <short8> <excerpt> — if replaced, run decisions supersede --id <short8>'); empty array when none. Warn-only: never refuse, no new required flag. The prose-guard refusal message also lists these candidates so the fix command is ready-made. Reuse the existing search ranking code (read.rs / search path) — no duplicate scorer. Registry description text for decisions log updated via hand-edit of generated registry_payload.json (precedent c06de083, no native regen chain).
verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml — new cases: candidate ranked and returned on tag overlap; >=2-term-hit candidate without shared tag returned; superseded target never a candidate; empty store / no-overlap yields empty array; prose-guard refusal carries candidates

trace.outcome: decisions log emits up to 3 ranked conflict_candidates (warn-only), reusing the search term-hit scorer; prose-guard refusal lists them too
